rules.statement: A change to anything the platform bootstrap runbook describes (bootstrap stack inputs, manual setup steps, verification commands, domains or account settings) updates the runbook in the same change.
rules.why: The runbook is a living document that must stay accurate for anyone reproducing the hosted platform from scratch; its status line requires that it be updated in the same change as anything it describes.
rules.check: Look for diffs to the bootstrap stack, its variables or outputs, or the manual-setup assumptions they rely on, that don't also edit docs/platform-bootstrap.md.
